pack.name: Azure Well-Architected Framework (extractor-aligned)
pack.description: Reviewer prompts mapped to Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework pillar themes. Grounded in read-only Azure extractor ZIP output (manifest.json, resources.json, optional policy-compliance.json and retail-prices.json) plus golden architecture manifest governance fields. Not an official Microsoft Well-Architected assessment or certification.

rules.title: Reliability — regional and zone redundancy documented
rules.description: When resources.json lists workloads across multiple Azure regions or availability zones, the architecture narrative must explain failover, RTO/RPO, and traffic routing assumptions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Correlate location fields on Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines, Microsoft.Sql/servers, and paired storage rows in resources.json; document active/active vs active/passive stance in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Reliability — Design for failure and redundancy (pillar theme)

rules.title: Reliability — backup and recovery expectations for stateful services
rules.description: SQL, storage, and Cosmos-class data planes inventoried in resources.json must show documented backup retention and restore testing commitments.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align datastores[].DatastoreType and RuntimePlatform with governance.PolicyConstraints naming backup cadence; cite extractor CollectionTimestamp when comparing inventory freshness to DR drill records.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Reliability — Backup and disaster recovery (pillar theme)

rules.title: Reliability — health monitoring for compute and PaaS hosts
rules.description: App Service, Container Apps, AKS, and load-balanced VM tiers should declare health probe and autoscale expectations traceable to manifest services.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record probe and scaling policies on services[].Tags and RequiredControls; when diagnostic exports exist in RawJson, confirm Application Insights or platform health signals are enabled.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Reliability — Monitoring and health models (pillar theme)

rules.title: Security — sensitive PaaS uses private connectivity
rules.description: High-sensitivity datastores must not rely on implicit public network paths when landing-zone standards expect Private Link.
rules.remediationGuidance: Set PrivateEndpointRequired=true on regulated datastores[] and align governance.ComplianceTags; cross-check Microsoft.Network/privateEndpoints rows in resources.json when network inventory switches were enabled.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Secure networking and private access (pillar theme)

rules.title: Security — encryption at rest for persisted data
rules.description: Manifest datastores carrying customer or regulated payloads must assert EncryptionAtRestRequired consistent with platform CMK or Microsoft-managed key posture.
rules.remediationGuidance: Ensure EncryptionAtRestRequired=true on sensitive datastores[]; document key custody (Key Vault, HSM) in governance.RequiredControls and relate to Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults inventory when present in resources.json.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Protect data at rest (pillar theme)

rules.title: Security — Azure Policy compliance states reviewed
rules.description: When policy-compliance.json is included in the extractor ZIP, non-compliant assignments should be dispositioned or risk-accepted with traceable governance narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Summarize Policy Insights non-compliance themes from policy-compliance.json in governance.PolicyConstraints; cite SubscriptionId and ScopeDescriptor for audit scope alignment.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Governance and regulatory compliance (pillar theme)

rules.title: Cost Optimization — compute SKUs justified against workload class
rules.description: Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines rows in resources.json should map vmSize choices to documented workload tiers; optional retail-prices.json supports unit-cost reasoning when IncludeRetailPrices was collected.
rules.remediationGuidance: Correlate properties.vmSize in resources.json with governance.PolicyConstraints; when retail-prices.json is absent, note that only inventory counts—not catalog estimates—are available until re-collection.

rules.title: Cost Optimization — resource tagging supports allocation
rules.description: ARM inventory tags on resources.json rows should support cost allocation, environment classification, and owner attribution expected by FinOps practices.
rules.remediationGuidance: Audit tags on inventoried resources and mirror mandatory tag keys in services[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags for manifest services not yet exported to Azure.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Cost Optimization — Improve cost visibility (pillar theme)

rules.title: Operational Excellence — centralized logging and diagnostics
rules.description: Platform diagnostics should converge to Log Analytics or equivalent sinks when Azure workloads emit audit and resource logs.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag observability commitments on services[].Tags; cite extractor ScriptVersion and RawJson summaries when diagnostic settings exports accompany the package.

rules.title: Operational Excellence — extractor evidence freshness documented
rules.description: Architecture reviews citing Azure inventory must record when evidence was collected and which extractor switches shaped the ZIP contents.
rules.remediationGuidance: Always cite azureExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp, SchemaVersion, and SwitchesUsed in metadata.ChangeDescription; upgrade AzModuleVersion when collector scripts change materially.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Operational Excellence — Operational procedures and evidence hygiene (pillar theme)

rules.title: Performance Efficiency — autoscale and SKU tier choices explained
rules.description: Compute and PaaS SKUs (VM sizes, App Service plans, SQL tiers) inventoried in resources.json require performance rationale when latency or throughput SLOs apply.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document scale rules and SKU decisions in governance.PolicyConstraints; relate Microsoft.Web/serverfarms and Microsoft.Sql/servers SKUs to services[].Purpose narratives.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Performance Efficiency — Select appropriate compute and data services (pillar theme)

rules.title: Performance Efficiency — edge delivery for internet-facing HTTP APIs
rules.description: Externally reachable APIs should describe CDN, Azure Front Door, or Application Gateway caching and TLS termination patterns that reduce origin load.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note edge attachment on ingress services[].Tags and relationships; when Microsoft.Cdn or Microsoft.Network/frontDoors rows appear in resources.json, tie caching policies to governance.RequiredControls.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Performance Efficiency — Use caching and content delivery (pillar theme)
